program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((bb2 (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 2)))
         (bb3 (bbox-of-cells (find-color g 3)))
         (r0 (max (first bb2) (first bb3)))
         (c0 (max (second bb2) (second bb3)))
         (r1 (min (third bb2) (third bb3)))
         (c1 (min (fourth bb2) (fourth bb3))))
    (empty-grid (+ (- r1 r0) 1) (+ (- c1 c0) 1) 8)))
